# Madina Crockery Store

> Sargodha's premier wholesale crockery supplier since 1949. Offering quality steel crockery, dinnerware, bone china, non-stick cookware, and wedding jahez supplies at wholesale rates.

## Core Navigation Pages

- [/](https://madinacrockery.vercel.app/) - **Home**: Overview of wholesale crockery supplies, featured categories (Premium Dinnerware, Heavy-Gauge Steel, Commercial cookware), customer testimonials, and contact inquiry portal.
- [/about](https://madinacrockery.vercel.app/about) - **About Us**: The history of Madina Crockery Store (serving since 1949 in Sargodha), our values, quality assurance, and wholesale supply commitments.
- [/contact](https://madinacrockery.vercel.app/contact) - **Contact**: Find location directions, operating hours, phone numbers, and WhatsApp links, or send an inquiry via our interactive contact form.
- [/faq](https://madinacrockery.vercel.app/faq) - **FAQ**: Frequently asked questions about shipping, wholesale orders, customized dinner sets, pricing, returns, and store policies.
- [/blog](https://madinacrockery.vercel.app/blog) - **Blog**: A comprehensive library of crockery guides, material comparisons, care instructions, and wedding checklists.
